description: This PHP source file defines the class `ZendeskHelpProcessor`, which implements help-related processing for Zendesk within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for constructing URLs for help articles, searching, and redirecting based on Zendesk API responses, and manages HTTP client interactions.

classes.name: ZendeskHelpProcessor
classes.description: A class that handles interactions with Zendesk help center API, such as building URLs and fetching help articles.

methods.name: getHelpConfigService
methods.description: Provides access to the HelpConfigService instance, creates one if none exists.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Returns an HTTP client instance, creating one if none exists.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the base URL for the help system from configuration.

methods.name: getSearchUrl
methods.description: Constructs the Zendesk search URL with a given label parameter.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Finds the appropriate redirect URL for a help topic based on Zendesk search results.

methods.name: sendQuery
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to a specified URL with optional content type, returning the response or null on failure.

methods.name: getDefaultRedirectUrl
methods.description: Returns the default redirect URL to Zendesk default help page.
